explanation: Raw update gate z of unit 22. Timing dominates (D2 ~0.98 saturated, D1 ~0.25, GO ~0.15-0.22; timing R^2 0.94). Beyond timing the variance is mostly at GO and tracks an observed-only a2/S2 lean: z rises when the ideal-observer belief favors S2 (negative belief_lo, steeper after an unrewarded trial), after an unrewarded a2 trial (+0.10), especially a2 -> S1 unrewarded (extra +0.06; total about +0.3 in the residual table), and falls after a rewarded a1 trial (-0.07). At D1 it is shifted by the previous rare transition (+0.08 after a2->S1 rare, -0.08 after a1->S2 rare); there is a small +0.03 lift after any unrewarded trial at D1/GO. D2 is saturated and barely varies. No future, hidden or model-output terms. Test R^2 beyond timing 0.63 (dev 0.64), vs all-observed reference 0.74 and all ceiling 0.83; the model policy decile alone gave 0.56, so dropping the model value/policy loses little: belief plus last-trial history covers it. Remaining misses are small (<0.04) per previous-trial cell.

issues: The stated scores reproduce exactly: test R^2 beyond timing is 0.628 (timing-only 0.936). Dropping any single term costs 0.01-0.06 (drop belief_lo*prev_unrewarded -> 0.577, drop last_is('a2 S1 u') -> 0.570, drop (phase!=D2)*unrewarded -> 0.565, drop D1 rare term -> 0.592), so every term contributes.

The D1 rare-transition claim needs a qualifier because it depends on reward for a2. The D1 residual table shows a2 S1 r at only +0.040 against a2 S1 u at +0.104, and misses reports D1 after a2 S1 r over-predicted by -0.037. The symmetric '+0.08 after a2->S1' holds mainly for unrewarded trials.

The claim that any unrewarded trial adds +0.03 at D1 is shaky. The D1 residual after a2 S2 u is -0.014, and misses over-predicts D1 after a2 S2 u by -0.034 and GO after a1 S1 u by -0.042. Those are the largest cell errors, but they are still small (<=0.042).

There is a remaining gap of about 0.11 to the all-observed reference (0.74), and I could not close it with simple terms. Adding 2-back history, a2 streaks, a belief nonlinearity (tanh, squared), belief_cover interactions or D1/D2 belief each gave <=0.004. The best single addition, (phase==GO)*ep_dec*clip(belief_lo), reached only 0.640. So the gap is spread out, not one systematic class.

The worst-fit windows are late-episode runs of unrewarded a2 trials (mostly a2->S1 rare unrewarded), where GO z reaches 0.85-0.9 against a prediction of about 0.53. That is a real under-prediction for the most extreme 'stuck on a2' runs. Streak terms recover almost none of it on average, so it is rare rather than systematic.

'Loses little' versus the model's policy is loosely supported. The only comparison given is policy decile alone (0.56) against 7 observed terms (0.63). The earlier policy-based explanation's own score is not reported, so the size of the loss is not actually quantified.
